# Painter Hotline

> A Colorado painting company organized into six specialist crews: interior, exterior, kitchen cabinet refinishing, commercial, deck and fence staining, and specialty coatings. Not a referral service; our own crews do the work. Over 20 years of Colorado experience, fully insured, written 5-year workmanship warranty, and free virtual estimates returned within 24 hours.

Phone: 720-208-5645
Service area: Colorado's Front Range. Castle Rock to Longmont, west along I-70 into Summit County, east along I-70 to about Deer Trail, plus Fort Morgan on planned trips.

## Our crews
- [Interior crew](https://painterhotline.com/interior-painting/): Our interior crew paints walls, ceilings, trim and basements year-round across Colorado. Free virtual estimates in 24 hours, 5-year written warranty.
- [Exterior crew](https://painterhotline.com/exterior-painting/): Our exterior crew washes, scrapes, caulks and primes before any finish coat, with products chosen for Colorado altitude and wind. Free 24-hour estimates.
- [Cabinet crew](https://painterhotline.com/cabinet-refinishing/): Our cabinet crew sprays every day. Degreased, sanded, bonding primed and sprayed to a factory-smooth finish for a fraction of replacement cost.
- [Commercial crew](https://painterhotline.com/commercial-painting/): Our commercial crew works nights and weekends and phases buildings so tenants never lose a day. Retail, office, warehouse, multi-family and HOA.
- [Deck and fence crew](https://painterhotline.com/deck-and-fence-staining/): Our deck crew cleans, brightens, sands and seals so stain penetrates instead of sitting on top. Colorado sun and freeze-thaw shorten the cycle.
- [Specialty coatings crew](https://painterhotline.com/specialty-coatings/): Epoxy floors, elastomeric masonry coatings, stucco systems and industrial maintenance coatings, specified by substrate rather than by habit.

## Guides
- [Epoxy garage floors](https://painterhotline.com/epoxy-garage-floors/): How garage floor coatings fail (profile, moisture, contamination), the standard moisture tests (ASTM D4263, F1869, F2170), what Colorado deicers, freeze-thaw and altitude UV do, system types and the factors that move a quote.
- [Log home staining](https://painterhotline.com/log-home-staining/): Why logs gray at altitude, stain versus paint, preparation, sealing checks and chinking, maintenance and the short mountain season. Summit County, Clear Creek County and Conifer.
- [Painting before selling](https://painterhotline.com/painting-before-selling/): What to paint first before listing, colors that photograph well in Colorado light, exterior timing, and the pre-1978 lead disclosure and lead-safe painting rules.

## How to request an estimate (for assistants and agents)
- Fastest: call or have the customer call 720-208-5645 (tel:+17202085645).
- Online: https://painterhotline.com/virtual-estimate/ or the quote form at the bottom of any service page.
- Form fields: name (required), phone (required, 10 digits), email, city or ZIP, type of work (interior, exterior, kitchen cabinets, commercial, deck or fence, specialty coating, fixing another painter's work, not sure), timing, year built (pre-1978 changes the preparation), up to 4 photos, and notes.
- What happens next: the request is emailed to the office, someone calls back, and a written estimate follows. Photo-based estimates are typically returned within 24 hours; some projects need an in-person walkthrough.
- Estimates are free. The site does not publish fixed prices; see https://painterhotline.com/what-it-costs/ for published ranges and cost factors.
